text:
Alice Chen: heads up — after shipping nova-7b-quant-v1 to dedicated, we’re seeing this odd repeat loop on multi-turn code completions and a ~2.5x token latency increase for long contexts.
Ben Morales: ugh. saw a couple reports from e2e tests. Is it deterministic?
Alice Chen: not fully deterministic but high signal. Short prompts ok, degen starts to show after ~1.5k tokens.
Carmen Ortiz: did anything change in KV cache handling between float and quantized builds?
Devon Li: we switched to the new packed-kv layout that’s faster in int4, but I ran a smoke locally and noticed misaligned cache keys in logs.
Alice Chen: attaching the condensed log excerpt here:```
[2025-11-13T14:02:11Z] request_id=rc-42 tokens=1530 step=decode kv_key=0x7f3a.. cache_index=2048
[2025-11-13T14:02:11Z] request_id=rc-42 step=decode kv_key=0x7f3a.. cache_index=0   # unexpected wrap
[2025-11-13T14:02:12Z] repeating token sequence detected after cache miss
```
Carmen Ortiz: that cache_index reset looks wrong. could be an integer overflow when converting from packed offsets.
Ben Morales: timeline: quant rollout at 03:00 UTC, first errors around 03:12, traffic on dedicated was 60% of pool. We autoscaled but latency stayed high.
InfraBot: deploy nova-7b-quant-v1 -> deployment/nova-dedicated-1 started at 2025-11-13T03:00:05Z
EVA-bot: alert: latency_p50 increased from 45ms to 120ms for model:nova-7b-quant-v1 between 03:10 and 03:20 UTC
Devon Li: repro steps I used: run long-horizon code prompt ~1700 tokens, use our quant build with packed-kv on CUDA ampere. Repro rate ~70%.
Carmen Ortiz: short-term mitigation: roll back to nova-7b-fp16-v0.9 on dedicated and mark quant as paused. Anyone object?
Ben Morales: +1 to rollback. We need to stop customer impact.
Alice Chen: starting rollback now. tagging @support to notify affected accounts.
InfraBot: rolling back deployment/nova-dedicated-1 to model nova-7b-fp16-v0.9 (requested by Alice Chen)
Ben Morales: after rollback, let's collect a minimized test case and bisect quant subcomponents: packed-kv packing, decoder-kernel int4 path, and cache offset math.
Carmen Ortiz: agree. I'll take packed-kv and offset math. Devon, can you reproduce and capture raw tensors for the failing requests? we need before/after kv arrays.
Devon Li: on it. will run with capture flags and upload to /mnt/ci/bug-dumps/nova7b/1789123456.tar.gz
Alice Chen: also seeing quality regressions on instruction-following (weird truncated code). Not sure if tied to same bug or a fallback path hitting quant-emu.
Ben Morales: we should run our eval suite (codegen short/long, instruction-following, hallucination set) against fp16 and quant and diff outputs; create per-test similarity metrics.
Carmen Ortiz: adding a quick config snippet suggested for debug (do not commit to prod):```
MODEL=nova-7b-quant-v1
KVCAPTURE=1
KV_DUMP_DIR=/tmp/kv-dumps
ENABLE_PACKED_KV=0  # disable packed layout to test alignment
```
Devon Li: that should indicate if packed layout is the culprit. I'll run with ENABLE_PACKED_KV=0 and compare.
Alice Chen: timeline & action items: rollback (done), Carmen = packed-kv/offset audit, Devon = tensor captures + run-disable-packed test, Ben = eval diffs + perf matrix, Alice = customer comms + incident note.
Ben Morales: estimated triage ETA 6h, full fix ETA depends on root cause complexity.
Carmen Ortiz: found a suspicious cast in packing code: `(uint16_t)offset - (uint8_t)base` that can underflow when offset>255. patch incoming for review.
Devon Li: enabled capture and repro with packed disabled — repro rate dropped to ~5%, so packed-kv is likely the main trigger.
Alice Chen: Carmen, when you open the PR add a regression test that runs long-context code example.
Carmen Ortiz: will do. PR branch: fix/packed-kv-offset-guard.
EVA-bot: deploy-bot detected new PR fix/packed-kv-offset-guard in repo inference-runtime (CI: queued)
Ben Morales: great. after PR, we should run quant regression harness across our fleet configs (ampere/v100/rtx) to ensure no hardware-specific behavior.
Alice Chen: thanks team. I'll post an incident summary in #incidents after we confirm patch and can coordinate a staged rollout. :thumbsup:
